title: Nell and the Bell
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds l, ll, ss
note_for_grown_ups: This book uses every Phase 2 sound, including the double letters ff, ll and ss. Point out that ll makes one /l/ sound in 'bell' and 'fell', not two.

pages.illustration: Nell the sunflower-yellow bee hovering beside a small bright red hand bell hanging from a twig. Strong red-and-yellow colour contrast.
Nell swinging into the bell with both front legs, the bell tipping. Show the ring as the bell blurred at the edges, not as symbols.
Nell swinging on the bell's clapper like a rope, upside down, absolutely delighted. Movement lines in an arc.
Pip arriving at a run across the grass, wings out, drawn to the noise. Motion from left to right.
Moss mostly hidden in a mud puddle, only a nose and two eyes showing, thoroughly pleased with his hiding place.
Pip skidding into the same puddle at speed, feet out in front, mud flying up in a wing shape. The moment before landing.

pages.text: Nell is not in the mud!
pages.illustration: Close on Nell hovering, perfectly clean, grinning down at the mud. Behind her, Pip and Moss both mud-brown and unrecognisable.

pages.text: Nell, Pip and Moss had fun.
pages.illustration: Closing page: all three lined up along a twig, caked in mud, the red bell above them, everyone laughing. Warm and messy.
